about: The five land pathways named in the challenge brief, as a starting list for matching laws to parcels. Each entry is a one-line summary from the brief plus an official source. The summary is NOT the rule: eligibility, lot-size limits and exclusions are in the source. Read it before you code a filter, and show the date you checked.

pathways.name: SB 9
pathways.what_it_opens: Lot splits and duplexes on single-family lots

pathways.name: SB 684 / SB 1123
pathways.what_it_opens: Small-lot subdivisions of up to 10 homes without a hearing
pathways.note: Lot-size limits differ by source and by bill. Cite the statute you used.

pathways.name: SB 4
pathways.what_it_opens: Housing on faith and nonprofit-college land

pathways.name: Condo conversion
pathways.what_it_opens: Converting existing apartments to ownership condos
pathways.note: No single statute summary listed here. Local condo-conversion rules and state subdivision map rules apply; find and cite them.
